firstPriorityAction: Design and launch customer loyalty program
whyFirst: Quick implementation builds momentum and shows progress
verificationMetrics: Loyalty program enrollment >50% of customer base
failureRisks: Customers engage for discount only, churn when offer expires
fallbackPlan: Pivot to referral program (existing customers get discount for bringing new customers)
reviewTriggers: After first intervention completion: validate assumptions, collect outcome data
Monthly: Track KPIs (repeat customer rate, turnaround time, complaint count)
If revenue does not improve by 20% within 60 days: pivot to alternative diagnosis
If team capacity exhausted: pause non-critical interventions
If external market changes significantly: reassess competitive positioning
allInterventions: Design and launch customer loyalty program
